# DeepSeek Harness - Save KV-Cache
Save and load KV cache slots on a llama.cpp server from within DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

> **0.2.0** adds a slot capability probe (auto-save goes dormant on servers without
> `--slot-save-p

ath` instead of posting blind 404s, with honest command errors) and
> bundle metadata for the DSH Pl

ugins panel ("Save KV-Cache" under Personal, with the
> standard toggle).
## Features
- **`/save-kv-cache`** — Save the current KV cache slot on the active llama.cpp server as `session-<

id>.bin`. Download icon.
- **`/load-kv-cache`** — Restore a saved KV cache file on the active llama.

cpp server. Data icon.
- **Auto-save** — Fires on every `turn/end` event and saves slot `0` as `sess

ion-<id>.bin`.
- **Capability probe** — Before saving, the plugin probes `POST /slots/0?action=resto

re` (10-minute
per-server cache). On servers without `--slot-save-path` (501 `not_supported_error` o

r a
router-style 404) auto-save stays **dormant** — no blind POST traffic at every turn — and the
ma

nual commands answer with the fix ("start llama-server with `--slot-save-path`") instead of a
raw `4

04 The model 'None' does not exist`.
- **Plugin panel** — Ships `dsh.bundle.patch` + `locale/en|zh.j

son` + `icon.svg`, so Plugins lists it
under **Personal** as "Save KV-Cache" (保存 KV 缓存) with the sam

e enable/disable toggle as the
built-in plugins.
## How It Works
### Save
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The llama.cpp server writes the KV cache from the specified slot into `--slot-save-path`.
### Load
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The server restores the saved sequence state into the slot. The command reports
`n_restored`, `n_rea
d`, and `restore_ms` from the server response.
### Provider selection

Commands and auto-save resolve the **active provider** from the session's latest
`request/header` (o

r `model/selection` event), then read that provider's
`baseURL` from `llm-pi-ai.providers`. This is

important when more than one
llama.cpp server is configured: saving against the wrong server writes

an
unrelated slot cache. The first configured provider is used only when no
selection exists yet.
## Commands
| Command | Description |

| `/save-kv-cache` | Save KV cache as `session-<id>.bin` |
| `/load-kv-cache` | Restore KV cache fro

m `session-<id>.bin` |
| Auto-save | Saves slot `0` on every `turn/end` using the active provider |
## Filenames

The code tries `session.title`, then falls back to `String(session.id)`. In DSH
`0.2.0-rc.2` the tit

le is a session event (`session/title`), not a property on the
session object, so the effective file

name is the session ID (e.g.
`session-<session-uuid>.bin`).
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness (DSH) `0.2.0-rc.2+`
- llama.cpp server with `--slot-save-path` configured
- Plugi
n installed in the profile's `node_modules` (see INSTALL.md)

From npm:

## Repository layout

The npm package lives in `plugin/` (`package.json`, `lib/`,
`locale/`, bundle patch, package README/

LICENSE, `test/`); this root holds the
full documentation — this README and INSTALL.md.
